experiment: Guard boundary validation: generation execution rewrites
conditional_note: Deliberately forced branch coverage, not a proposed quality policy; same conditional reference in each pair.
comparison: Each real denoise step replayed from identical tensor/cache/layer/RNG state against original FlashU; reference state and prediction advance trajectory. Record every step for CADD-only, Vocab-only, and combined. Finite branch test, not a universal equivalence proof.
correctness: Exact prediction tensor equality, diffusion cache and layer/AG future-state equality, CPU/CUDA/Python/NumPy RNG equality, observed trunk/vocab call counts and bypass counts; stop and retain on any mismatch.
zero_hit_measurement: Paired synchronized model-call wall time, restoring state before interval; no observation hooks, hashing or IO inside interval. Alternating order. Calibration trajectory excluded. Includes DLS selection and guidance. Not end-to-end pipeline latency.
scope: New real-model tests cover generation guards and specified text/Qwen labels APIs. Understanding KV/gather/mask/EOS evidence is separate; no claim of universal interface coverage.
